verdict.rationale: uv is a Python package and project manager. It has no concept of user 'automations' (workflows, scheduled jobs, or agent routines) that it could version, review, or roll back, so this story is a category error for this kind of product. Lockfile pinning and versioned tool invocation (e.g. `uvx ruff@0.6.0`) cover dependency reproducibility, which is a different capability and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
